caption: The drawing depicts a wooden cabinet composed of two sections: an upper display section and a lower storage section. The upper section is framed in medium brown wood and features an arched glass-fronted display area with two shelves inside. At the back of the upper section, there is a decorative, fan-shaped green panel with a central motif resembling a shell or flower. The arch and corners of the upper frame are accentuated with wood detailing, including triangular insets at the top corners. Below the display area is the lower section, consisting of two rectangular doors with raised panels and wood grain texture, also finished in medium brown. The cabinet stands on a short, bracketed base, and the background is plain, off-white or beige, with no additional ornaments or objects.
title: Corner Cupboard
